'''Lake Marudi''' was a [[Water/Legends|lake]] on the [[Forest/Legends|forest]] [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Endor/Legends|Endor]] that consisted of two separate, smaller bodies of water connected by a thin, water-filled ravine.<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|II|242|Lake Marudi}}</ref> It was located 3.1 [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]] (2 miles) south-east of the [[Ewok/Legends|Ewok]] inhabited [[Bright Tree Village/Legends|Bright Tree Village]] and to the west of the lake the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] constructed a [[Endor shield generator bunker|shield generator bunker]].<ref name="Inside" /> In order to avoid having to travel around the lake, Ewoks hung a rope-bridge across the strait of Lake Marudi,<ref name="CSWE" /> and in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]],<ref name="Date">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]] to [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]].</ref> an army of Ewoks from Bright Tree Village traveled across the bridge with several allies from the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] while trekking toward a rendezvous with other [[Endor strike team/Legends|Rebel forces]] at the bunker before they [[Battle of Endor/Legends|attacked]] the [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial forces]].<ref name="Inside" />

==Behind the scenes==
Lake Marudi was first mentioned in the [[2004]] reference book ''[[Inside the Worlds of Star Wars Trilogy]]'', which was written by [[James Luceno]] and illustrated by [[Richard Chasemore]] and [[Hans Jenssen]].<ref name="Inside" />
